## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

   **Pricing and paywall.**
      6 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Feb 18, 2026 - Jul 24, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Antong.lv_, Jul 24, 2026, 1/5: "I paid 5 Euros for this app. As I understand, the features were meant to stay. Now, the app is free and all the features I used to have and actually PAID FOR got REMOVED or to precise are now hidden behind a second paywall. It’s not a lot of money but this is this a straight scam, sadly I really liked to use the app but this is plainly stupid. I hope I can get a refund from Apple"
            2. _eyyy helo ther_, Jul 18, 2026, 1/5: "I paid for this, why an ad still popped up?"
            3. _w y_, Jul 9, 2026, 1/5: "paid for Forest plus and still got ads (not the optional ones for extra rewards)"

## **Ads pressure** {#theme-ads}

   **Ads pressure.**
      2 recent review(s) mention ads pressure.
      Review window: Jun 23, 2026 - Jul 13, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users are noticing ad pressure. This can signal monetization friction and an opening for a cleaner competitor.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _w y_, Jul 9, 2026, 1/5: "paid for Forest plus and still got ads (not the optional ones for extra rewards)"
            2. _TheReviewersreview_, Jun 23, 2026, 1/5: "This app sucks now because you guys putting too many ads!"
            3. _I just wanna read da Bible_, Jul 13, 2026, 3/5: "I really love this app (that I bought years ago), and as a graduate student I used to use it frequently. Recently, I needed a way to re-balance my time, and thought to re-download. Now it’s loaded with tons of ads and requests to purchase premium. It still works, but it’s a bit much and is irksome to use especially considering I paid for it (eg unskippable ad after most sessions?)"

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      8 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Apr 11, 2026 - Jul 20, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Mukul Gupta_, Jul 17, 2026, 1/5: "Overtime this has only got more buggy and laggy. Not what I expected after buying the premium subscription."
            2. _purplesony_, Jul 20, 2026, 2/5: "I use this primarily to do short hourly focus sessions with a buddy in another location. We’ve been using it pretty successfully for almost a year, but it’s becoming more and more glitchy as more “features” are added. In the past 3 days, it’s crashed on us a minimum of 10x/day."
            3. _Antony Filyk_, Jul 19, 2026, 2/5: "They've added subscription-based monetisation after I already purchased premium. Also, there is this annoying red dot notification that doesn't go away no matter what you do. The UI is buggy, for the subscription based service with heavy in-app monetisation this is a really bad business practice. I don't like how this app that supposedly should help battle distractions becomes the distraction itself."
